scientific_role: independent adjudication of the exploratory order-preserving action-basis repair
code_revision: the immutable Git commit containing this protocol; record its SHA in every run manifest

external_outcome.visual_boundary: calibration-only dataset-matched rendered RGB from recorded simulator states; not untouched raw sensor RGB
external_outcome.outcome_use: evaluation only; forbidden for fitting, normalization, calibration, thresholding, model selection, or protocol revision

candidate_protocol.required_bank_match: candidate IDs and complete action sequences must exactly match the development bank

decision_rule.pass: all primary conjunction clauses pass on roots 1900-1999 without protocol modification
decision_rule.fail: retain the independent negative result and localize the failed clause; the same roots cannot be reused as confirmatory data after revision

claim_boundary: Passing establishes an external fixed-bank realized-state consequence for an intervention-supervised latent/action adapter. It does not establish frozen-predictor dynamics, adaptive CEM, untouched raw-RGB planning, universal world modeling, or a universal commutator certificate.
